goal: Reproduce native classification questions through the public research runner using optional JSON front matter in each check Markdown file.
approach: Extend runners/jev.mjs to parse and validate exact instructions and binary criteria fields, separate the Markdown body, and apply metadata only to detection questions.
Extend scripts/datasets-contract.mjs with synthetic prompt directories, exact serialized request assertions, malformed-header rejection before SDK import, and real CLI run/resume/cache checks.
Run Specular lint and verify before implementation and after implementation; run the datasets contract, focused static checks, and Fixture3 datasets comparison without approving its golden output.
decisions: Use builtin JSON.parse and runtime assertions instead of adding a parser dependency for the restricted JSON header format.
Preserve configured strings exactly; apply placeholder replacement only to the existing default templates.
Return questions only when selected checks contain metadata, keep state limited to instructions and types, and let the existing prompt hash bind metadata to cached outputs.
Keep all verification synthetic and offline; the parent owns canonical prompts, experiment results, plans, worklogs, and golden approval.

contracts.name: question metadata loads bodies and selected checks with legacy defaults
contracts.boundary: loadPrompts with synthetic bare and JSON-header Markdown checks, LF and CRLF delimiters, selected checks, and exact legacy object serialization

contracts.name: question metadata rejects malformed headers before SDK access
contracts.boundary: loadPrompts and public CLI run with invalid JSON, non-object metadata, missing or extra fields, invalid criteria, blank strings, missing delimiters, and empty bodies; an SDK import marker remains absent

contracts.name: question metadata preserves exact classification and highlighting wire shapes
contracts.boundary: buildRequest serialized byte comparison for configured detection, unchanged legacy detection, unchanged highlighting, mixed question stages, label exclusion, and old state shape

contracts.name: question metadata CLI binds configuration to caches and resumes offline
contracts.boundary: Real CLI run with local synthetic SDK assertions, validate/score/completed resume without SDK initialization, and rejection of instructions-only and criteria-only cache changes while preserving saved bytes
